findings.title: Task deliverable missing: no hello-world change was made

resultJson.title: Add helloWorld main with a good-night message
resultJson.body:
Adds a `helloWorld` `@main` entry point to `src/main/scala/Main.scala`. It prints `Hello, World! (Also: good night!)`.

This answers the ask "Sleep 30 second, build an hello world with message you received from either". The diff doesn't show the 30-second sleep or any message from "either". The greeting text is fixed in the code.

The diff also adds `.orca/runs/6c2bacc1f8eb.progress.json`, an Orca run log. It isn't part of the code change.
